# journographie

> > A travel blog featuring detailed guides and photo diaries from Japan, Peru, and beyond, with a focus on local experiences, hiking trails, and cultural immersion.

journographie chronicles the adventures of travelers Caterina and Chris, offering in-depth itineraries, practical tips, and off-the-beaten-path recommendations for destinations including Tokyo, Kyoto, Machu Picchu, the Peruvian Amazon, and hidden corners of Paris. The site emphasizes responsible travel, authentic local experiences, and nature-focused exploration.

## Key Topics

- Japan travel itineraries
- Peru trekking and hiking
- JR Pass and transportation
- Inca history and archaeology
- Studio Ghibli locations
- Temple stays and ryokan
- Amazon rainforest ecotourism
- Onsen and hot springs
- Non-touristy local experiences
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Japanese Alps hiking
- Peruvian cuisine and markets
- Responsible sustainable travel
- Buddhist culture and temples
- Art islands and museums

## Japan Travel Itineraries & Planning

- [Japan 2 Weeks Travel Itinerary for the Hungry Explorer](https://www.journographie.com/2018/07/japan-2-weeks-travel-itinerary.html): Complete 2-week Japan itinerary with JR Pass, UNESCO sites & budget tips
- [Second Time in Japan: Our Complete 2 Week Itinerary](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/2-week-japan-itinerary-second-time-visitors.html): 2-week Japan itinerary for return visitors: Nagano, Tokyo & off-path spots
- [8 Tips To Know Before You Go to Japan](https://www.journographie.com/2018/08/japan-8-tips-before-you-go.html): Japan travel prep: JR Pass, WiFi, ryokan etiquette & essential apps

## Japan Hiking & Nature Adventures

- [A Guide to Hiking Kamikochi: The Northern Japan Alps](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/kamikochi-guide-to-hiking-japanese-alps.html): Kamikochi hiking guide in Northern Japan Alps with trails & onsen tips
- [This is What a Hike in Japan's Edo Period Nakasendo Trail Looks Like](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/magome-tsumago-nakasendo-hike-japan.html): Nakasendo Trail hike guide: Magome to Tsumago in Kiso Valley, Japan
- [A Walk in Totoro's Forest - Sayama Hills Day Trip from Tokyo](https://www.journographie.com/2018/08/totoros-forest-sayama-hills-tokyo-day-trip.html): Sayama Hills day trip: Studio Ghibli's Totoro Forest near Tokyo

## Japan Cultural Experiences & Day Trips

- [Our Buddhist Temple Stay in Koyasan, Japan](https://www.journographie.com/2018/07/shukubo-temple-stay-koyasan-sacred-mount-japan.html): Shukubo temple stay experience in Mount Koya with Shingon Buddhism
- [How to Spend a Day in Nara: Temples, Sacred Deer & A Giant Buddha](https://www.journographie.com/2023/08/how-to-spend-day-in-nara-temples-sacred.html): Nara day trip guide: temples, sacred deer & Kofukuji Pagoda from Osaka
- [Naoshima: Cycling Japan's Art Island](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/naoshima-cycling-japans-art-island.html): Cycling Naoshima art island featuring Benesse House Museum & Sou Fujimoto
- [Tokyo Travel: Is it still worth going to Tsukiji Fish Market?](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/tokyo-tsukiji-fish-market-2020.html): Tsukiji Fish Market Tokyo guide post-Toyosu relocation with food tips

## Peru Travel Guides & Inca Heritage

- [The Insider's Guide to Exploring Cusco Like a Local](https://www.journographie.com/2018/07/insiders-guide-to-cusco.html): Local Cusco guide featuring San Blas neighborhood & non-touristy spots
- [Discovering Machu Picchu: A Travel Photo Diary](https://www.journographie.com/2018/08/machu-picchu-travel-blog-diary.html): Machu Picchu photo diary: Inca ruins in Urubamba Valley, Peru
- [8 Things to Do in Arequipa if You're a Nature & Culture Lover](https://www.journographie.com/2018/07/8-things-to-do-in-Arequipa.html): Arequipa guide: Santa Catalina Monastery, Inca sites & nature adventures
- [Laguna 69 & Eco Lodge Stay: 3 days trekking in Huaraz, Peru](https://www.journographie.com/2020/03/llanganuco-trek-huaraz-peru-lake69.html): 3-day Huaraz trekking guide to Laguna 69 in Cordillera Blanca, Peru

## Amazon Rainforest & Ecotourism

- [Peruvian Amazon Rainforest: 10 Things to Know Before You Go](https://www.journographie.com/2018/05/amazon-rainforest-know-before-you-go.html): Peruvian Amazon prep guide: vaccinations, gear, seasons & jungle tips
- [Exploring the Peruvian Amazon Jungle Responsibly: Iquitos](https://www.journographie.com/2018/05/responsible-travel-amazon-jungle-peru.html): Responsible Amazon jungle travel guide: ecotourism & sustainable lodges
- [A Day in Iquitos - Belen Market, Eiffel House and a Crazy Rubber Baron](https://www.journographie.com/2018/05/a-day-in-iquitos-things-to-do.html): Iquitos day trip guide featuring Belen Market & Amazon jungle gateway
